messages.subject: Re: Ubunutu R base Problem
parts:
Hi

You should read http://cran.rstudio.com/  in Download R for linux section> ubuntu . Basically consists in edit (as root or using sudo) the /etc/apt/sources.list adding 7

   deb http://<my.favorite.cran.mirror>/bin/linux/ubuntu trusty/  for example

  deb http://cran.rstudio.com/bin/linux/ubuntu trusty/
and execute in terminal
sudo apt-key adv --keyserver keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys E084DAB9

for secure apt.

After that you can install newest R version using usual apt-get update , apt-get upgrade , apt-get install r-base r-base-dev




El 20/04/15 a las 14:53, Jason Watts escribió:
I am running Shiny server on Ubunutu. I am wanting to run some dashboards I have built using Shiny dashboards but I cannot instal all of the dependancies because the R-base on the Ubuntu repository is a older R build required by the dependancies. I think 3.0. The error is telling me I need 3.1 or greater. I have tried to install a .deb build of the latest R build but I cant because Ubuntu is telling me I should use the one in the repositiory. Can somebody tell me how I can upgrade my R-base in Ubuntu to the latest R build?
 
Thanks.
